cohort: Patients undergoing labor induction were divided into three groups based on whether they received 25 ug vaginal misoprostol, 25 ug sublingual misoprostol, or vaginal dinoprostone pessary.
finding: Low-dose vaginal or sublingual misoprostol was found to be more effective and safer than vaginal dinoprostone pessary for labor induction.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery rates were significantly higher with vaginal and sublingual misoprostol compared to vaginal dinoprostone pessary, which had higher cesarean delivery rates.
